persistence.reason: The browser suite uses the deterministic in-memory simulator and does not claim database persistence.

limitations: Browser APIs were served by the deterministic simulator, not the Java 17 BPI service.
No browser-to-PostgreSQL end-to-end persistence was performed in this UI suite; START-to-END closure used the deterministic simulator.
The Java 8 authentication adapter and ADP session bridge have separate target evidence; this deterministic browser suite did not retest the target environment.
Target MES shell, PostgreSQL and RBAC persistence acceptance are tracked separately and are not implied by these simulator results.
Flink application and runtime-readiness states were exercised through deterministic simulator controls; no real IoT, Kafka, Flink, WOM, QCS or WMS integration was exercised in this browser suite.
No real mobile device, weak-network or accessibility acceptance was performed.
